voice.note: One ElevenLabs take (voice: Hope, Eleven v3), cut at its pauses. from/to bound the speech in the take; at is when that speech starts in the piece, on the original's beats.

voice.level_note: The original narration's loudness, measured from the original mix minus the bed. It puts the voice about 12 LU over the music, as in the original; levels then matches each line to the same line of the original narration.

music.title: One Button music bed
music.note: The original video's own music, voice removed (supplied by the project owner). It lines up with the original recording, whose clip starts 0.288s in, so it plays from 0.288s; its hits already land on the original's cuts.
music.level_note: Played at the bed's own level, which is the level it has in the original film (it sits in the original mix at unity, within 0.5 dB). No extra ducking: the original's moves under the narration are already in the bed.

master.note: No loudness normalisation, so the mix lands where the original does (-16.7 LUFS in stereo; the original's mono track reads -19.7). The limiter is only a safety.
